avis.titre: Refreshing & Effective – Just Be Aware of the Quantity
avis.texte: These collagen masks are absolutely wonderful! They leave my skin feeling hydrated, refreshed, and noticeably smoother after each use. The serum is rich without being sticky, and the masks adhere well to the face, making them perfect for a relaxing self-care routine. The packaging is cute and the masks themselves feel high-quality. I noticed a visible glow after just a couple of uses, and they’re gentle enough for sensitive skin. However, the only downside was the misleading product description regarding how many masks come in a set. I expected more based on the listing, so it was a bit disappointing to receive fewer than advertised. That said, the quality of each mask is excellent, so it still felt like a worthwhile purchase—just something to keep in mind before ordering. Overall, these collagen masks deliver great results and make a lovely addition to any skincare routine. Just double-check the quantity before buying!

avis.titre: Quick, Effective, and Perfect for a Skincare Boost
avis.texte: I absolutely love this collagen mask! Unlike another popular collagen mask on the market, this one doesn’t require you to wear it overnight. The directions recommend removing it after just 30-50 minutes, making it perfect for those who want all the benefits of collagen without committing to overnight wear. The formula is packed with an impressive 2,160,000PPB of real collagen, and the results are amazing. My skin feels softer, more hydrated, and noticeably firmer after each use. It’s lightweight and absorbs beautifully, leaving no sticky residue, so it’s easy to use anytime you need a quick skincare boost. I also love the individual jar packaging—it keeps the product fresh and is super convenient for travel or single-use applications. If you’re looking for a quick, effective collagen treatment that delivers hydration and elasticity without the overnight wait, this is a fantastic option. Highly recommend! I use my nail to cut the mask between my eyes and the corners of my nose for a more seamless application. I also did a couple slits along the outer edges for a perfect fit. The smell is neutral, which I appreciate, and it leaves my skin glowing.

First off, I almost NEVER review ANYTHING unless I REEEALLY love it, or REALLY hate it, and it's 4am and I'm trying to go back to bed, so take that for what it's worth. Saw lots of reviews on reels for this particular mask, so I thought I'd give it a shot. I put it on about 10:30ish last night, and was able to sleep in it no problem, after it set for about 30 minutes or so it was stuck well enough that I didn't have to worry about it slipping off, and took it off around 3:45am. My results are obvious!! The first "after" picture I took was such a stark difference I retook it to make sure the shadows/angle was the same (I took both pictures in the same bathroom, same lighting), and even after doing that the difference the mask made is wild for a single treatment. I'm hoping the results last for a while, I'll be back to review again in a few weeks with that info an if frequent use furthers the results!!

I thought I had found the perfect face mask, but I’m very disappointed. I always make sure to carefully check the ingredients of products before purchasing because my skin is highly sensitive to PEGs, phenoxyethanol, alcohol, and perfumes. On the product page, the ingredients list appeared clean and fantastic, so I decided to give it a try. However, when the product arrived, I checked the ingredients list on the back of the box and was shocked to see PEG-100 listed. Worse, it’s near the top of the list, indicating a higher concentration. PEGs are known to cause sensitivity, burning sensations, redness, and irritation for many people, including myself. It’s frustrating that this company, despite having an otherwise great formulation, would include an ingredient that can harm sensitive skin. This makes it clear they don’t prioritize their customers' skin health. While the other ingredients are fantastic, I really hope they reconsider and remove PEGs from this formula. Unfortunately, I’ll be returning this product. I highly recommend Biodance Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask and NACIFIC Rice Pepta Collagen Gel Facial Mask, which are made with clean ingredients over this product. If you wear it overnight and wake up in the morning, you'll be surprised at how much your entire face is lifted! I love them soo much! Plus, you can get a 24-pack of Biodance face masks at Costco for around $73! Recommended for all skin types.

avis.texte: I ordered this after seeing tons of reviews and videos of women swearing by the miraculous glassiness of their skin after one use. I may have gone into this expecting too much from my 45 year old face. I found this mask to be hydrating, thick jelly like quality and a bonus for my face and skin softness. I kept the mask on for 6 hrs and let everything soak into my face as instructed. I did have some issues with getting it to stop slipping around, but once it dried a bit it stopped slipping. I’m not a fan of the size and wish that it were a little bit larger for better facial coverage. I’m not mad at it, as long as it’s giving my face a drink, but I just wasn’t overly impressed. I feel I could have gotten the same result just using my collagen cream and it would have saved me some frustration. I’ll continue using the rest of the product, and if I feel differently I’ll update my review.

avis.titre: GLOWY LOOK ONLY LASTS 1-2 HOURS, NOT WORTH IT
avis.texte: Purchased and wanted to give it a shot because I keep seeing everyone using it and leaving them glowy. I purchased in hopes that I would be the same which I was but giving 4 stars because yes while it does leave you glowy after taking off, the glowy look only lasts about 1-2 hours so that was disappointing. I applied it at night, had it on all night long (did not slip off, slept on my back), and took off in the morning. For the price I was expecting better for all the hype on it. Wouldn’t purchase again and would just stick with my skin care routine especially my tretinoin and vitamin c!

avis.titre: After a year of consistent weekly use I can say it works!
avis.texte: I’ve been using these consistently for a year, once a week. Some weeks I manage to sleep in them; most of the time I wear it from after dinner to until I go to bed, maybe 4-5 hours! I’ve noticed a huge improvement in my skin texture and brightness over the past year. This is a before and after, before photo taken about a month before starting use, they just happen to be in the exact same spot and lighting too on the same iPhone. This is the only thing that has changed in my routine over the last year. I’m the exact same weight. My diet is the same. I’m likely drinking less water because diet Dr pepper is my only solace in this insane world. Anyway, buy it and use it consistently. It’ll work!

avis.titre: The best collagen hydrating mask - hands down!
avis.texte: The best hydrating mask! Wake up with glowing, glossy skin! The deep collagen mask is my favorite! You can wear either over night or for a few hours. It’s not sticky, the mask itself is very durable. Apply evenly onto face & shine later! It definitely does the job! Worth every penny.

avis.titre: Don’t listen to the instructions leave these on overnight
avis.texte: I am 41 years old and when I use one of these every Friday, I put it on before bed. Wait about 15 minutes for it to adhere to my face. I use all the little cut outs where I want to add extra moisture sometimes on my neck, sometimes closer to the bottom of my eyes And my Cupid bow instead of keep it on up to 45 minutes, fall asleep in it. You won’t get anything on your pillow. You won’t even realize it’s there after the first 30 minutes of wearing it and you will wake up with glass skin that takes the moisture so well that that second picture of me where my skin is still shining is the Thursday before I need to mask again! Every penny I even think these are trending on TikTok. If you want to see how to use them overnight, this is the tiniest hyaluronic acid molecule that has ever been created for a skin care and you should make sure you absorb every single Ounce of it! Trust me, you will thank me in 10 years

I LOVE using this mask. I use it once a week or every two weeks. It makes my skin feel so soft and healthy. After wearing the mask the previous night (I wear it all night) and applying my make up that next day, my face looks glowy. Even without make up, my face still looks amazing and healthy. I receive so many compliments about how good my skin looks. I’m almost 40 and I feel like I don’t look it (I hope I don’t look it lol) 💛

avis.titre: By far my favorite face mask
avis.texte: I love these face masks! When they go on, they’re very white and thick and as it sits on your skin, it becomes clear. I noticed my fine lines and wrinkles are smooth. My skin is hydrated. I also feel like my acne scars are not as noticeable. I’m trying to do this mask at least three times a week.
Check out my before and after, especially the 11 lines between my eyes. The after is right after removing the mask. We'll see how long it lasts but I have to say I'm pleased.
Bought this about a month ago and it does not work today. Do not waste your money on this. There are parts of the light on the neck portion that aren’t working and the whole mask isn’t working.
